task: 4.4 Apply cdk-nag dispositions for new findings
method: Backed up the pre-refresh cdk.out/*-NagReport.csv baselines, re-ran `cdk synth` for both apps under the upgraded aws-cdk-lib/cdk-nag, then diffed the resulting NagReports against the baseline by (Rule ID, Resource ID). Every finding surfaced under the upgraded toolchain is either Compliant or carries a NagSuppressions entry (added via the repo's existing `CdkNagUtils.suppressCDKNag` -> `NagSuppressions.addStackSuppressions` pattern) that references the rule id with a written justification.
newRuleResourceRows: none — the upgraded cdk-nag (2.38.2) produced an identical set of (Rule ID, Resource ID) rows to the 2.36.18 baseline for both apps. No genuinely new rule fired on any resource.

dispositions.justification: Cognito plus tier / feature plan (advanced security features) is unnecessary for a workshop.
